name: chess-world
description: Interactive Chess World — a chess game where every move is choreographed. Knights leap in a real arc, rooks charge behind a shockwave, bishops streak down the diagonal, queens dissolve into particles and rematerialise, captured pieces burst apart, and the camera covers all of it. Hand-written chess engine (legal move generation, SAN, alpha-beta search in a worker) with no chess library, rendered with the PlayCanvas engine under a Nuxt 4 UI.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:perft && npm run check:games
